additional_info.subject: RE: ID0428956-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2/R5 313059216002]  QA26 Safety relay error CRM:02682000122
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Please see below, where both emergency stop and ELMS have triggered the emergency stop and safety relay.
You can see in the above it says “ELMS tripped 35K”. As part of the ELMS, there is a bit in the control word “ELMS_NoTrp_A”.
This is used to communicate to the charger that the ELMS (external PLC) was responsible for trip
However, I believe that because you are contacting us, your customer is not aware of the PLC/ELMS intentionally tripping the charger?
If you could confirm the above, that the PLC did not trip the charger, then we will require on-site investigation on this topic.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd. Australia
Customer Services
Application Service Engineer
Phone: +61 499 701 794
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com

additional_info.subject: RE: [EXTERNAL] RE: ID0428956-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2/R5 313059216002]  QA26 Safety relay error CRM:02682000122
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Thanks for the phone call today. Series of events below for the latest in the Springs Saga.
Both Chargers were showing Un-available on both Ocean and Ewon (PLC) portal with a QA-26 fault.
Issuing a remote e stop to the chargers did not help the issue.
Technician visited site and found both chargers LEDs were red – yet the LCD screen looked healthy to start a session ( No photos of this sorry )
Tech found that E stop was pressed on SPJ02 put not pressed on SPJ01.
When he released the Estop on SPJ2, both chargers LCD screen came up with the “E-stop is pressed” message.
Tech cycled power to both chargers which successfully cleared the faults on each.
Estops on each charger were then tested onsite which were successful
I initiated a remote Estop test for each charger via the PLC. E stop for SPJ 1 was successful but SPJ 2 did not reset remotely. The tech had to press and reset the Estop on site for it to reset.
I think the chargers are ok , it seems to be something with the PLC side of things which I will follow up.
Cheers,
Liam Lubransky
Asset Management Technician
Asset Deployment & Operations
Meridian Energy Limited
New Zealand
M. 027 8399974

additional_info.subject: RE: 0428956 - ID0428956-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2/R5 313059216002]  QA26 Safety relay error CRM:00312000074
additional_info.body:
Dear Liz,
Just wanted to inform you that this case will now be closed.
Problem Description:
Chargers were out of order with QA26 Safety relay tripped.
Resolution:
Emergency stop button was pressed on the charger. During the same time, the ELMS has set the trip line for the emergency stop and was reporting to the charger it was tripped.
Customer stated they will follow this up from their side and request any further assistance as needed.
If you need any further assistance, you can get in contact with us here → www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
